narrative.text: Merchant MID100138 declared home_furnishing at onboarding 654 days ago. Telemetry dissents: the largest deviations from the home_furnishing baseline are round_share_drift at +12.0 sigma (observed 0.354 against a category baseline of 0.00022), velocity_drift at +12.0 sigma (observed 1.15 against a category baseline of -0.00183), velocity_recent at +6.5 sigma (observed 2.76 against a category baseline of 1.65). The homepage surface presents a crypto_exchange interface at 0.94 confidence, against a declared category of home_furnishing. This vertical cannot be approved on this platform. In total 2 independent views of this merchant contradict its declaration. The investigation used 2 of a permitted 8 steps and stopped because confidence threshold met. Recommended tier is Restricted pending review with settlements held, because the storefront dissents and telemetry corroborates.
